scope: Source-presence and output-projection investigation for AC1012 DICTIONARY cloning, prompted by the MLINESTYLE conversion gate. No parser or admission behavior changed.

authority.odaSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 sections 20.4.44 and 20.4.73: DICTIONARY cloning and hard-owner fields are R2000+, whereas MLINESTYLE has a pre-R2018 linetype index.
authority.interpretation: Autodesk describes group 281 value 0 as not applicable and 1 as keep existing; these are distinct. No authoritative R13-to-modern-DXF default rule was found.

inputs.independentLocalSourceProvenance: Local Bowlingova_kuzelka.dwg; original producer unknown; not committed.

observations: ODA File Converter 27.1 produced and reopened the locally authored line drawing as AC1012. On conversion to R2010 DXF it emitted 42 DICTIONARY records, all with group 281=1; the ACAD_MLINESTYLE root was handle 0x10, owned by NOD 0xA, with one soft-owned Standard entry 0x22.

LibreDWG 0.14 converted the same AC1012 bytes to R2010 DXF with group 281 absent from all 42 DICTIONARY records, including the same root and entry handles; its log reports unstable-class warnings. ezdxf 1.4.5 assigns its own default 1 to an absent cloning attribute. This is an independent reader convention, not proof of AutoCAD semantics.

A separate locally generated LibreDWG AC1012 control parsed 30/30 frames in libdxfrw. A scratch-only extension of existing source-bound MLINESTYLE admission converted it in strict mode and passed mutation/refusal, retry and ASCII/Binary readback. Its four emitted source dictionaries explicitly use 281=0. ODA rejected this generated DWG before conversion with an AcDbDictionary-to-AcDbEntity cast error, and three related LibreDWG-generated controls were likewise rejected or required recovery. The candidate was reverted and its output is not qualification evidence.

The independently available Bowlingova_kuzelka AC1012 source is accepted by ODA; its MLINESTYLE fields and NOD→dictionary→style identity agree with libdxfrw, but its original producer is unknown and libdxfrw observes an unrelated object parse failure. Whole partial export also meets a separate LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD backlink gate. The raw dictionary key differs in case from the style name and must be preserved rather than normalized silently.

tool.behavior: Bounded ASCII-DXF group inventory reports an explicit cloning value or null for absence and the rooted MLINESTYLE entry, without assigning a default. Its built-in controls check group framing, reactor versus owner, absent versus explicit values, duplicate flags and malformed input.
tool.fixtures: All drawings and conversions remain in scratch/local locations; no DWG or DXF fixture was committed.

next: Establish a source-presence-aware projection for legacy dictionaries, including NOD and nested paths, caller edits, versioned duplicate-merge semantics and exact staged output. Resolve the ODA/LibreDWG/default distinction with an eligible native or independent semantic witness before admitting this profile or claiming lossless output.
limits: The successful scratch candidate involved an ODA-rejected generated source and was removed. The separate ODA-readable source proves only bounded MLINESTYLE fields and ownership, not full output or native clone behavior. No support claim or phase gate is promoted.
